sourceTitle: A Course of Lectures on the Principles of Domestic Economy and Cookery
description: "A Course of Lectures on the Principles of Domestic Economy and Cookery" by Miss Juliet Corson is a practical guide on domestic economy and cooking techniques written in the late 19th century. The work captures a series of lectures delivered to women attending the University of Minnesota to better equip them for home management and culinary skills.
